_readme: Documented, reviewed exceptions for `npm audit --omit=dev`. Entries here are production-dependency advisories that are known, triaged, and intentionally deferred rather than silently ignored. Every entry MUST have a tracking reason. Anything NOT listed here must fail CI at high/critical severity. See issue #100.

exceptions.reason: Fix requires the Nest v10 -> v11 major upgrade (touches @nestjs/platform-express, @nestjs/websockets, @nestjs/platform-socket.io, @nestjs/terminus together). Deferred to a dedicated follow-up PR with a full regression pass (unit + e2e + websocket gateway + Soroban indexer), not something to force in an audit-fix pass.
Patched multer only ships via @nestjs/platform-express@11.x (Nest v11). Same Nest major-version follow-up as GHSA-36xv-jgw5-4q75.

ReDoS only reachable via the `$data` option, which this codebase's validation schemas do not use. Transitive via @angular-devkit tooling pulled in by @nestjs/cli (dev-only) as well as file-type; low real-world exposure. Will resolve naturally once @nestjs/cli and @nestjs/platform-express are bumped.
DoS via malformed ASF media parsing; server does not accept ASF uploads. Fix ships via @nestjs/common file-type bump, currently blocked on the same dependency graph as the Nest v11 upgrade.
ZIP decompression bomb DoS via [Content_Types].xml; server does not accept ZIP/office-document uploads. Same follow-up as GHSA-5v7r-6r5c-r473.

Stack exhaustion when deep-merging recursive/attacker-controlled object graphs. Transitive via prisma -> @prisma/config, used only to load prisma.config.ts at CLI/build time; it merges Prisma's own static config objects, not runtime request input, so it is not reachable by any attacker-controlled data. Verified prisma@7.9.1 (latest stable 7.x) still pulls deepmerge-ts@7.1.5 (<8.0.0, vulnerable); the only fix is the not-yet-stable prisma@8.0.0-rc.x line. Revisit once prisma 8 reaches a stable release.
